origin: Outcome-blind source+wind admission run 39391834277, source GPS MD5 8789e188f1b33af9d4d8c810cded005a; weather/site support 41 candidate birds (separate from 40 other-bird shared-cell candidates).

meteorology.sites: four site centroids from ref tags deployed in 2016
meteorology.primary_var: wind_speed_100m m/s, site-centred; not GPS point meteorology
meteorology.regime: per site-month calendar-day means Q25/Q75, middle excluded
meteorology.same_grid_month_permutation: sites mapping to the exact same gridded wind coordinate share a permutation schedule; same calendar date labels shuffled between dates within grid×month to preserve mesoscale correlation
meteorology.weather_frozen_verification: Recompute original source run's site/month Q25/Q75, qualifying dates, and CERRA response grid coordinates exactly; stop if weather data has drifted, do not redefine quartiles.

selection.one_per_bin: first eligible x-y/time/speed GPS per bird/date/5-min bin before altitude availability
selection.quality: finite raw height-above-msl in [-300,3000]m; overall >=0.8 of preselected 5-min flight bins; missing earliest height never replace with later GPS
selection.day_shape: subtract median native height across all selected valid flight GPS fixes within each bird-calendar date. Estimand is post-session shape, not live prediction of absolute height.
selection.training: for each individual and 5km cell, all nonempty other UTC days, wind-pooled versus same wind regime; return no estimate without >=10 independent donor events in SAME wind state and >=10 in OPPOSITE wind state after excluding target day
selection.heldout: test identical events for both models. Scored bird-day >=20 fixes. Bird needs >=2 separately scored dates in each wind regime. >=10 birds overall for inferential reporting.
selection.weighted_score: For each scored day mean per-record log P(z_center|own bird,cell,wind)/P(z_center|own bird,cell). Within bird mean of low-day scores and high-day scores, weight low and high equally. Mean across birds; per-bin Jeffreys pseudocount 0.5.
selection.independent_units: Bird primary, bird-day intermediate. GPS fixes never independent scientific replicates.

calibration.block: shuffle full site-level day wind regime labels among calendar dates within exact CERRA grid-cell×year-month, preserving CERRA-shared dates across overlapping site grid cells. Recompute training support and bird eligibility every draw.
calibration.null_gate: valid randomization if >=10 bird-level scores and finite; at least 950 of 999 valid null draws. Retain all unavailable draws, p_lower=(1+b)/(1000), p_upper=(1+b+unavailable)/(1000), observed >valid-null-mean AND conservative p_upper<0.05 required for support.
calibration.one_primary_test: CERRA wind explanatory context for within-bird day-centred height shape, no posthoc grid/regime/mode optimization.

descriptive.per_wind_day_tail_fraction: mean per bird per wind of |altitude-median(day)|>50m, equal birds; purely descriptive, not separate inferential success
descriptive.stationary_negative_control: Original DELTATRACK result at different site/tag context is not a same-study negative control. Do not pool or subtract its magnitude.

limitations: Observational regional colony wind does not measure local orographic lift or wind encountered at each bird's actual 3D position.
Wind and tag measurement quality/weather are not causally distinguishable with GPS alone.
Speed threshold is a flight proxy, not verified wingbeat/soaring behavior.
Within-year day exchangeability assumes no unmeasured date drift beyond site-month/weather.
Only one species, different breeding sites, original source not 162 birds simultaneously observed.
no_rescue: Fail quality/bird/null gates as unavailable; do not relax 5km,10/20,regime quantiles or alter year following inspected heights.
